summary: Applied both triaged spec review findings by specifying read-only pre-prompt official discovery and public/local config separation for official state writes.

items.title: Fresh bootstrap path lacks a pre-config integration contract
items.rationale: Specified that fresh setup discovers official preset metadata through a read-only pre-prompt path that does not create target config or installed package state, and that persistence only happens after confirmation for non-base official selections.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[1], constraints[7], overview.data_flow[1], overview.data_flow[3], requirements[R2], acceptance_criteria[A1], tasks[T-2] now define pre-prompt read-only discovery and post-confirm persistence semantics.

items.title: Official state writes must preserve config.local overlay privacy
items.rationale: Added an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion that official state mutation must preserve public/local config separation and must not publish local-only plugin sources or packages.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints[8], requirements[R8], acceptance_criteria[A8], tasks[T-3].acceptance, and tasks[T-3].implementation_notes now require public-config-only mutation semantics.
